errors.evidence: The description claims the categories on the horizontal axis are listed in random order, but the bars are clearly sorted in descending order of their value.

The description incorrectly transcribes the category label, which is "Прекъсване на конкуренцията / пазара" (Disruption of competition / market), not "Прехвърляне на конкуренцията" (Transfer of competition).
The description incorrectly transcribes the category label. The chart shows "Природно бедствие" (Natural disaster), not "Промяна на природните бедствия" (Change of natural disasters).

The description incorrectly combines three distinct categories ("Финансови / ликвидност", "Технологичен провал", and "Прекъсване на конкуренцията / пазара") into a single non-existent label. It also misquotes one of the labels as "Прехвърляне на конкуренцията".
The bar for the category "Неизправност" (Malfunction) corresponds to a value of 20% on the y-axis, not 22%.
The bar for the category "Правни / регулаторни" (Legal / regulatory) corresponds to a value of approximately 19% on the y-axis, not 20%.
The bar for the category "Киберпрестъпления" (Cybercrime) corresponds to a value of approximately 16% on the y-axis, not 18%.
The description states that "Други" (Other) has the lowest percentage. However, it is tied with "Тероризъм" (Terrorism) at approximately 5%, so it is not the sole category with the lowest value.
